content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To find silver and gold tools in animal crossing: new leaf, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a silver shovel from the Museum Shop (2 minutes)
Step 2. Donate at least 15 fish to the museum (2 days)
Step 3. Donate at least 15 bugs to the museum (2 days)
Step 4. Talk to Blathers daily to build rapport (1 week)
Step 5. Unlock the Museum Shop renovation (3 days)
Step 6. Donate at least 15 fossils to the museum (3 days)
Step 7. Wait for the Silver Axe to appear in the Island Shop (5 days)
Step 8. Catch all 72 types of fish to impress the fishing tourney host (4 months)
Step 9. Pop 15 balloons with a standard slingshot (2 hours)
Step 10. Donate at least 15 works of art to the museum (1 month)
Step 11. Receive the Gold Net from Nat during the Bug-Off (10 minutes)
Step 12. Buy the Silver Rod from the Museum Shop (1 minute)
Step 13. Talk to Leif about gardening achievements (5 minutes)
Step 14. Plant a variety of flower seeds around town (1 hour)
Step 15. Store your new tools in your house (10 minutes)
Step 16. Pull 50 weeds in your town (30 minutes)
Step 17. Use the Gold Shovel to bury a bell bag (1 minute)
Step 18. Buy 50 bags of fertilizer from the Gardening Store (50 days)
Step 19. Earn the Master Angler badge (2 months)
Step 20. Win the Fishing Tourney gold trophy (1 day)
Step 21. Buy 50 saplings from Leif (50 days)
Step 22. Receive the Gold Rod from Chip (5 minutes)
Step 23. Shoot down the golden gift balloon (1 minute)
Step 24. Maintain a Perfect Town rating (15 days)
Step 25. Check the Island souvenir inventory (5 minutes)

Step 29. Equip your gold tool to show off (10 seconds)
Step 30. Catch 50 different species of deep-sea creatures (1 week)
Step 31. Start a new save file in Animal Crossing (10 minutes)
Step 32. Earn the Gold Watering Can from Isabelle (5 minutes)
Step 33. Pull a silver watering can from the museum shop (1 minute)
Step 34. Catch all species of bugs available in summer (1 month)

Step 43. Upgrade the museum to the second floor (5 days)

Step 45. Earn the Gold Slingshot by hitting the golden balloon (1 minute)
Step 46. Display the silver tools in the museum (10 minutes)
Step 47. Buy a Gold Axe from Leif (1 minute)
Step 48. Check the mail for a letter from the HHA (1 day)
Step 49. Participate in the Weeding Day event (4 hours)
Step 50. Clean up the beach of all shells (20 minutes)
Step 51. Buy 50 bush starts from the Gardening Store (50 days)
Step 52. Talk to Leif after buying 50 saplings (2 minutes)
Step 53. Win the bug-catching contest (6 hours)
Step 54. Buy 50 flower seeds to unlock the Silver Watering Can (50 days)
Step 55. Earn enough medals on the island for a tool (3 hours)
Step 56. Catch the rarest butterfly in the game (1 hour)
Step 57. Use the Silver Slingshot to hit two balloons (5 minutes)
Step 58. Ask a neighbor for a spare tool (5 minutes)
Step 59. Place your gold tools in a display case (5 minutes)
Step 60. Catch a Coelacanth in the rain (2 hours)
Step 61. Shoot down the silver gift balloon (1 minute)
Step 62. Win the gold badge for bug catching (2 weeks)
Step 63. Take a photo of your character with the tools (1 minute)
Step 64. Purchase the Silver Shovel from the museum (1 minute)
Step 65. Donate a rare painting to the museum (10 minutes)
Step 66. Catch 100 fish in a row without failing (3 hours)
Step 67. Earn the gold badge for fishing (2 weeks)
Step 68. Show your gold tool to a friend (5 minutes)
Step 69. Complete the art wing of the museum (6 months)
Step 70. Buy 50 tree saplings to get the Golden Axe (50 days)
Step 71. Clean up the town's trash items (15 minutes)
Step 72. Invite a friend to see your gold tools (10 minutes)
Step 73. Maintain a "Great" town rating for 15 days (15 days)
Step 74. Pick up a discarded watering can (1 minute)
Step 75. Pull all the weeds in the morning (1 hour)
Step 76. Receive a letter of commendation from the Mayor (1 day)
Step 77. Catch the final bug needed for the encyclopedia (1 hour)
Step 78. Complete the bug exhibit (3 weeks)
Step 79. Reach the "Expert Hunter" rank (1 month)
Step 80. Obtain the Silver Slingshot from the sky (1 minute)
